text:
Anya: Dropped a trimmed mock for a compact autoscale rail. Need quick takes: visual priority, pool selector, and SLO guardrails. Link in PR.
Samir: Max should be prominent. Users think top-down: Max then Min. Make Max bolder and first in tab order.
Maria: Dev note: UI fields must map to API: min_instances, max_instances, burst_capacity, slo_target. Keep burst visible for cost hints.
Kevin: Accessibility: steppers need aria-labels ("Min instances", "Max instances"); SLO slider needs aria-describedby and a polite aria-live announcer for value updates.
Jen: Copy: use "Burst (temporary)" + tooltip: "Temporary extra instances that scale down automatically; billed while active." Add microcopy under SLO: "Lower SLO = lower cost, higher throttle risk."
Priya: Pool selector: for >20 pools use a searchable modal with badges (GPU type, region). Add an "Auto-select best pool" option.
Samir: Inline cost delta idea again: show subtle "(+1.9% est)" next to Max so users see tradeoffs quickly.
Anya: Agree. @Maria please add telemetry event names to the PR; @Kevin paste a short a11y checklist.
Maria: Events I'll add: autoscale.open, autoscale.change_max, autoscale.change_min, autoscale.toggle_burst, autoscale.select_pool, autoscale.set_slo, autoscale.preview. Payloads include user_id and prev/new.
Kevin: Short checklist: role=dialog for pool modal; focus trap; aria-labels for steppers/slider; aria-live announcer for numeric changes; aria-pressed for pool rows; keyboard order validated.
deploy-bot: Design feedback created DR-3610 024. Link: https://jira/redwood/DR-3610
Anya: Thanks. If no objections I'll merge tonight and follow up with a short ops playbook on burst behavior.
